{
  "dataset_name": "adult_income",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized age using training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-1.64, 3.87],
      "feature_family": "continuous_scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth, zero-centered continuous feature ideal for linear SVM margins, preventing the age scale from dominating the regularization penalty.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 38.709) / 13.289"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized education_num using training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-3.56, 2.28],
      "feature_family": "continuous_scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardizes the education level to a zero-centered scale, allowing the linear model to weigh education equally against other continuous features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(education_num - 10.143) / 2.570"
    },
    {
      "name": "hours_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized hours_per_week using training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-3.35, 4.87],
      "feature_family": "continuous_scaling",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes working hours to improve gradient descent convergence and margin calculation in linear SVMs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(hours_per_week - 40.939) / 11.930"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_net_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed net capital gain (gain minus loss, floored at zero) to handle extreme right-skewness.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 11.52],
      "feature_family": "log_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the massive range of capital gains into a smooth, roughly linear scale, preventing large outliers from distorting the SVM decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(capital_gain - capital_loss, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_loss_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed capital loss to handle skewness and provide a continuous severity measure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.38],
      "feature_family": "log_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the impact of extreme capital loss values, providing a more stable continuous feature for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_loss)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_education_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized interaction term between age and education_num.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the combined effect of age and education in a single linear feature, allowing the linear SVM to approximate non-linear interactions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((age - 17.0) / 73.0) * ((education_num - 1.0) / 15.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "hours_education_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized interaction term between hours_per_week and education_num.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a composite feature representing the combination of high education and long working hours, useful for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((hours_per_week - 1.0) / 98.0) * ((education_num - 1.0) / 15.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_full_time_adult",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for individuals aged 25 or older working at least 40 hours per week.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "logical_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a sharp linear decision boundary feature for a common demographic segment, aiding the SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((age >= 25) & (hours_per_week >= 40), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_stability_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall financial stability based on age, education level, and capital gains/losses.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, continuous severity measure of financial health that a linear model can easily weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "career_advancement_potential",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic evaluation of potential for career growth based on occupation type, education level, and age.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes complex categorical relationships (occupation, education) into a single continuous score suitable for linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "work_life_balance_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of work-life balance based on hours_per_week, marital_status, and relationship status.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates categorical family structures and continuous working hours into a unified linear feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_representation_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic index assessing demographic representation based on race, sex, and native_country.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Condenses multiple demographic categorical variables into a continuous index, reducing dimensionality for the linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
